facts.text: Veronica says the teleported steak tastes synthetic.
facts.why: In the transcript Veronica tries the teleported steak, says it tastes funny, and when Seth asks how, answers 'synthetic'.
facts.fix: Veronica says the teleported steak tastes wrong.

facts.text: The Bartok press party where Seth meets Veronica.
facts.why: Wikipedia has Seth meeting Veronica at a press event, and the transcript has Stathis saying he sent her to the Bartok party. Seth also says Bartok Science Industries financed his work.
facts.fix: The press party where Seth meets Veronica.

vibe.verdict: The steak test, vomit drop doughnuts and the Bartok party print on a dark lab sheet, but Be afraid does not print and the Veronica badge shows the Brundlefly photo.
missing: I'm an insect who dreamt he was a man
ideas: Swap the note on 'Sugar dusted doughnuts' for 'Dissolved first, then eaten. Ask the chef how.'
Replace 'Steak done properly with béarnaise' with 'Control steak' and a note on the one teleported next to it.
Swap 'Candied spiced pecans' for 'Brundle's museum jar' of salted peanuts with a plastic tooth on the side.
Add 'Be afraid. Be very afraid.' as the footer line in place of the 'Return tray to the hatch' joke.
